stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Technology can extend remembrance, but it should not force one style of mourning on everyone.”?

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Even above Earth, trash matters.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Technology can extend remembrance, but it should not force one style of mourning on everyone. Even memory needs consent.」，答案為「Even memory needs consent.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Even memory needs consent.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
